datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on November 04, 2025
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of November 04, 2025, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20251104]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery from Sentinel-1 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map flood extent polygons through image classification. The resulting flood boundary shapefiles and map products represent observed inundation areas caused by typhoon-induced rainfall and storm surge as of the acquisition date, enabling temporal tracking of flood progression.
